text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project better. In addition, regular reviews improve the overall quality of the team's work, since everyone follows the same standards. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth it. They make the code safer, the team stronger, and the final product more reliable.
